column3: NASB renders “smallest of all the seeds” as “smaller than all other seeds” and “perching” as “nest”; the Old Testament phrases are in capitals.
“From the foundation” is rendered “since the foundation”; the quotation is in capitals.
NASB follows the critical text without “Jesus” and with “explain.”
NASB has no “answering” and no “to them”; the critical text has “answering,” and “to them” is from the Textus Receptus.
NASB follows the critical text without “this” after “age”; “consummation” is “end.”
“All the causes of sin” is rendered “all stumbling blocks.”
NASB follows the critical text with “ears” alone; “the righteous will shine forth as the sun” is in capitals.
NASB adds “again” to “hid,” and renders “for the joy of it” as “from joy over it.”
NASB follows the critical text without “Jesus says to them” and without “Lord.”
NASB supplies “Jesus” and renders “master of a house” as “head of a household.”
“The region of Him” is rendered “His hometown.”
NASB follows the critical text with “Joseph.”
